username.label: NRK email
username.description: The email of your NRK account. Optional: live radio and podcasts play without one. With an account, the podcasts you follow sync to your library.

password.label: NRK password
password.description: The password of your NRK account.

nrk_session.label: NRK login
nrk_session.description: The cookies of a radio.nrk.no browser login, as one Cookie header. Use it when the email and password login is refused, since NRK often asks for a captcha.

manifest.description: Stream live radio and podcasts from NRK, the Norwegian public broadcaster. Log in to sync the podcasts you follow and your listening progress.
